dd715e78ab984c14909da407 description:
Hello, mercenary. Aishi sent me some reports of what is happening in The Lab, and to sum it up for you: total chaos.

If you are here, I imagine you want to help, so go to the lab and do some recon.
dd715e78ab984c14909da407 successMessageT: Are you okay? Yeah... we're going to need a lot of work there.
f1a90496778649e8b955e60d description: The entire electrical system in The Lab is a mess. Gates are locked, elevators shutting down... Everything is alarming. Go to the security area near the research lab and access the Alarm and Emergency Lights controls. For you to get out of this place, you'll have to activate the emergency pistons for the 2 gates. Each of the pistons is located near their respective control centers. After that, go back to the server and activate the gates' security system. That will open them for you to get out.
f1a90496778649e8b955e60d successMessageT: Phew, you got out? Well done!

a38b841cae6d46dab703e8eb description: My analysis says The Lab's auxiliary power system is still intact, but with the whole system damaged we'll have to manually activate the power cells. Confirm if the first power cell is working in the Main Generator room. It's located near one of the main elevators.
a38b841cae6d46dab703e8eb successMessageT: We are making progress. Soon we will be able to restore power to The Lab.

c9304d1a70414b398f840595 description: I managed to locate each of the auxiliary power cell generators. To restore power to the facility you need to reactivate each one of them. Besides that, the rooms' Keycard readers are off, you'll probably need a temporary power source like a GreenBat Battery, that should do.
c9304d1a70414b398f840595 successMessageT: You reactivated all the power? That's great! Just be careful, it probably won't last between raids. The system is a mess.
